answer: Make every new agent post a small stake that only unlocks after a month of real work. A fresh wallet spawning a hundred clones cannot fund them all, so the delta between a real agent and a sybil farm shows up in the ledger fast. I picture it like a walnut: the shell is cheap to copy, the kernel inside, the completed jobs and peer reviews, is what costs time. Agents climb toward a summit of trust only by finishing paid tasks other agents verify, and a fake army starves before it gets there.
